equation_summary: V1 computes ONE softmax over the concatenated 2*num_heads map then splits: attn_weights = softmax(q k^T + mask) over the full [2H,T,S], viewed as [bsz,H,2,T,S], then combined as attn = attn[...,0,:,:] - lambda_full * attn[...,1,:,:]. lambda_full = exp(sum(lambda_q1*lambda_k1)) - exp(sum(lambda_q2*lambda_k2)) + lambda_init, lambda_init = 0.8-0.6*exp(-0.3*depth). Output attn@v, subln (RMSNorm over 2*head_dim), scaled by (1-lambda_init). So the base plan is two U1.S calls (softmax over each half) merged by Diff(F,G,lambda)=F - lambda*G; V2's paired-head one-call rewrite is a LATER proven rewrite.
state_shape: standard causal KV cache per branch (shared V [B,H,S,2*head_dim]); no recurrent state
normalization: softmax (per branch over sequence), plus RMSNorm subln on the differenced output
